connector.name: Pipedrive CRM
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Pipedrive CRM. 155 tools for deals, persons, organizations, activities, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package pipedrive-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ckalima account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PIPEDRIVE_API_KEY
env.description: Your 40-character Pipedrive API token (Settings > Personal preferences > API).

env.name: PIPEDRIVE_MODE
env.description: Server-enforced capability tier: 'read-only' (reads only), 'safe-write' (reads + non-destructive writes; the default), or 'full' (all tools, including destructive). Out-of-mode tools are hidden from tools/list and refused if called directly. A blank value is treated as unset (defaults to safe-write); an unrecognized value falls back to read-only.

env.name: PIPEDRIVE_ENABLE_DESTRUCTIVE
env.description: Legacy flag, superseded by PIPEDRIVE_MODE. When PIPEDRIVE_MODE is unset, 'true' maps to full; otherwise prefer PIPEDRIVE_MODE=full. Still honored for back-compat.

env.name: PIPEDRIVE_IMAGE_BASE_DIR
env.description: Allowlisted directory the server may read product images from when a file_path is passed to the image-upload tools. Filesystem reads are disabled unless this is set, and a file_path must resolve within it.
